Ivy N.: quick heads-up — onboarding script failing preview step because the 'kv-cache' runbook anchor is missing (link: https://kb.internal/docs/deploy/kv-cache#troubleshooting). Anyone want to take a tiny fix?
kb-link-bot: Scan found: fragment '#troubleshooting' not present in docs/deploy/kv-cache.md. Header changed to 'Troubleshooting & notes' -> new id '#troubleshooting--notes'. Recommend adding explicit id or aliases in frontmatter to preserve old fragments.
Daniel F.: I can handle a minimal PR to add an explicit id on the H2: `## Troubleshooting & notes {#troubleshooting}`. Keeps visible text and restores fragment compatibility.
Rohit S.: Thanks Daniel. Can you also ripgrep for hardcoded refs in onboarding and scripts? `rg "kv-cache#troubleshooting" -n ci/ onboarding/ docs/ || true`
Ivy N.: good call. Daniel, if you push the PR tag `@eng-docs` in the description so owners get pinged it should move fast.
docs-owners-bot: CODEOWNERS note: path '/docs/deploy' owned by @eng-docs, @onboarding-squad. Owners approval required for merge if match.
Daniel F.: will include owners tag and a short changelog entry. Perl one-liner I tested locally: `perl -0777 -pe "s/## Troubleshooting(?!\s*\{)/## Troubleshooting {#troubleshooting}/s" -i docs/deploy/kv-cache.md`
Rohit S.: I can review after you open PR. Ping me and Ill do quick CR. Also consider adding `aliases` in frontmatter if you think the page slug changed elsewhere.
Ivy N.: I ran `rg` pre-PR: only onboarding/setup.sh references the old fragment (one hit). I'll paste output in the PR description.
Daniel F.: opening PR in ~7m. Will include rg output and a one-line changelog. Tagging @eng-docs.
Rohit S.: happy to approve after quick lint. Thx! :+1:
Ivy N.: thanks team — small ops but big UX for new hires. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
